description: This PHP class 'PendingSelfReviewSummary' is part of the OrangeHRM system. It defines a data transfer object (DTO) that summarizes pending self-reviews for an employee. The class constructs search filter parameters based on the employee number and specific review statuses, and provides methods to retrieve a group ID, group name, and count of pending self-reviews.

classes.name: PendingSelfReviewSummary
classes.description: A DTO class representing a summary of pending self-reviews for an employee within the OrangeHRM system. It initializes search filter parameters in the constructor and provides methods to retrieve group info and pending review count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with the employee number and relevant review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with this review summary, fixed at 4.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for this review summary, 'Pending Self Reviews'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending self-reviews using the employee action summary service and the prepared filter parameters.
